lunyoro: Bene baitu, inywe mumanyire ngu okuruga omu biro byaira, Ruhanga akakomamu halinywe, Abamahanga bahu'le omuk kanwa kange ekigambo ekyenjiri, kandi baikirize.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] The elders met together to fight against the Lord and Christ.
lunyoro: Nabakuru bakesoroza ahamu, okurwana na Mukama na Kristowe:

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] No one told him about it because of the fear of the Jews.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho muntu ayamugambireho bwa obwokutina Abayudaya.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] That is why God raised him from death to life, because we cannot hold him sacred.
lunyoro: nuwogu Ruhanga yahumbuire obuyabohoroire okuhu'rwa okwokufa: baitu tutasobole kumukwatira kimu.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] But I think that I am not completely lost by the desire of the elders.
lunyoro: Baitu nintekereza nti timbuzirweho na kake nabakwenda abakuru mali.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] Whatever you do, whether in word or in deed, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus, and give thanks to God the Father through him.
lunyoro: Kandi ekimurakakoranga kyona, rundi omu kigambo, rundi omu ngeso, mubikolege byona omu ibara rya Mukama waitu Yesu, numusima Ruhanga Isitwe omuruwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] Speak evil of yourselves, and pray for one another, in order that you may be healed. The prayers of a righteous person and the power of prayer may do the same.
lunyoro: Mugambanganege ebyokusisa byanyu inywenka nainywenka, kandi musabiranganege, nukwo mukizibwe. Okusaba kwomuntu ahikirire nokusobora muno omu kukora kwakwo.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] let your light shine before men, and let them see how good and how good they are in your service to your Father in heaven.
lunyoro: Omusana gwaanyu nukwo gwakege guti omu maiso gabantu, barole engeso zanyu ezisemire, nukwo bakugize Isinywe ali omu iguru.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] Let no one deceive you about this matter, because you know that we are in such a bad way.
lunyoro: omuntu wena aleke okutabatabana omu kusalizibwa kunu; baitu inywe mumanyire ngu nukwo twaterirweho.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] For now we live in many parts of the body, but we live in one body.
lunyoro: Baitu hati bunu ebicweka bingi, baitu omubiri gumu.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] John was baptizing in Enon near Salim, but there was much water there. They came to be baptized.
lunyoro: Kandi Yohana akaba nabatiza omu Enoni haihi na Salimu, baitu nuho hakaba hali amaizi maingi: baija babatizibwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] For the priesthood will be changed.
lunyoro: Baitu obunyakatagara obubuhingisibwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] The great day of the Lord's anger has not yet come.
lunyoro: Ekiro ekya Mukama ekikuru ekyatukirire kitakaizire:

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] I am telling you, both Jews and Gentiles, that you should turn to God and believe in our Lord Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: nimbabatebeza Nabayudaya Nabayonani, okwegarukamu hali Ruhanga, nokuikiriza Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo,

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] Now, then, you and the Council speak to the commander and bring him before you. You want to know the truth about him. Even if he has not come near us, we will be ready to convince him.
lunyoro: Nukwo hati bunu inywe hamu norukurato mugambire engabwa enkuru, amusirimule namberemuli numusisana nimwenda okumanyira kimu amananu agebigambobye: kandi nobwaraba atakairire haihi itwe twetekanize okumuzinda.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] When he finds it, I tell you, he rejoices to see how much joy this man has in healing him! It is like a large bundle of flour that has not yet been broken.
lunyoro: Kandi obwaba agizoire, mananukwo nimbagambira nti agisemere'rwa egi okugikiza ziri ekyenda mu mwenda ezitabuzireho.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] The man who had been betraying Jesus gave him a sign, saying to them, “I want to. Arrest him!”
lunyoro: Kandi ogu akaba namugobeza akabaha akokuro'raho, nabagambira ati Oundanywegera, nuwogu; mumukwate.

english: [GOVERNMENT] [GOVERNMENT] You are the ones who have been given the Law, just as the angels were commanded, and do not obey it.
lunyoro: inywe abahairwe ebiragiro nkokubyaragirwe bamaraika, kandi mutabikwate.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] I am telling you the truth: whoever believes in me has eternal life.
lunyoro: Mali mali nimbagambira nti Anyakuikiriza ayina obwomezi obutahwaho.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] Now there is no condemnation to those who belong to Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: NUKWO hati bunu busaho kucwera omusango hali abo abali omu Kristo Yesu.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] We do not look for the things that are seen, but for the things that are unseen. These things are seen by the things that are seen by the things that are seen; but the things that are unseen are unseen by the things that are seen by the things that are seen by the things that are seen by the things that are seen by the things that are seen by the things that are seen by the things that are seen by the things that are seen by the things that are seen.
lunyoro: itwe okutase'ra ebirukurorwa, baitu ebitarukurorwa: baitu ebi ebirukurorwa byokuhwaho; baitu ebitarukurorwa byebiro byona.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] Sell anything that is sold in the market before you buy it.
lunyoro: Kyona ekinyakugurwa omu katale mukirye, mutakaguise kigambo ebwomutima;

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] It is not more joy for me to hear my children say that they are walking in the truth.
lunyoro: Tinyina okusemererwa kwingi okukira kunu, okuhu'ra ebyabana bange ngu nibagedera omu mazima.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] They were forty years old and were not the ones who had been dead; yet their bodies were buried in the grave.
lunyoro: Kandi nibaha abayabihirirwe emyaka amakumi ana? tinibo abasisire? emitumbi yabu eyagwire omu irungu?

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] It is written in the Law, ‘I will speak to these people in strange tongues, but they will not understand,’ says the Lord.
lunyoro: Kikahandikwa omu biragiro ngu Omu ndimi ezindi nomu minwa yabandi ndigambira abantu banu; kandi tibalimpu'ra, nukwo Mukama agambire ati.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] He had one son, whom he loved. Then he sent him to them and said, “My son, they were afraid.”
lunyoro: Akaba akyanyina omu, omwana owagonza: hanyuma yamutuma nambere bali, nagamba ati Baratina omwana wange.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] When the sun is setting, it will not shine on it, and it will not shine on it.
lunyoro: Kandi obugumara kuija, gugisanga esingolire, etarumu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] Do not look for food that will last; rather, work for the food that remains for eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For he is the Father, and he will rule as king over you.
lunyoro: Mutakole'ra byakurya ebihwaho, rundi mukole'le ebyokurya ebikiikaraho okuhika obwomezi obutahwaho, Omwana womuntu ebyalibaha: baitu Isitwe, nuwe Ruhanga, amutaireho ogu akokuro'raho.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] But if someone tells you, ‘This is all you have to do with idols,’ then do not be fooled by them; they do not stop because of the one who tells you the truth and because of the one who tells you from the heart.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu obwaba nabagambira ati Kinu kihongirwe ebisisani, mutaryaho, habwogu anyakumanyisa ekigambo, kandi habwomutima:

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] You will fill my eyes with joy.
lunyoro: Olinyijuza okusemererwa amaiso gawe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] But because of your knowledge, the weak one will be destroyed, and the brother of Christ will die.
lunyoro: Baitu obwokumanya kwawe ogu atanyina amani ahwereke'ra, mwene waitu Kristo ouyaferire.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] He went on to do this, arrested John, and put him in prison.
lunyoro: yayongeraho kinu, yakwata Yohana namuta omu nju yenkomo.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repent.
lunyoro: Ntaije okweta abahikirire, baitu abasisi okwegarukamu.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] For even if you do not talk, I will not fool you by your hypocrisy, because you belong to all of you.
lunyoro: Baitu nobundi mudomadoma omu kubaza, tindimudomadoma omu kumanua; baitu omu buyona halinywe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] For I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you.
lunyoro: baitu nyowe nimbagambira nti Mugonzege abanyanzigwa banyu, musabirege abanyakubahiga,

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] So then, you will say, ‘This is why the weeds are cut off, and I am made clean.’
lunyoro: Nukwo oragamba ngu Nikyo amatagi gacwerirweho, nyowe nsimbwemu.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] When he found one pearl of high value, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.
lunyoro: obuyazoire eruru emu eyomuhendo omwingi, yagenda yagura ebyakabanyinabyo byona, yagigura.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] The child grew up to be a very strong man, and he was filled with wisdom. The grace of God was upon him.
lunyoro: Kandi omwana akakura, yafoka wamani, yaijura amagezi: embabazi za Ruhanga niziikara haruwe.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] The word of it reached the ends of the world.
lunyoro: Iraka ryabyo likahikya ensi ha mpero yensi zabantu bona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] These people were shown that they did not belong to themselves, but to you, and they sent out what you have now told them to preach the Good News through the Holy Spirit who was sent from heaven. These are the very things that the angels wanted to see.
lunyoro: Kandi nibo basukulirwe ngu tihali habwabu bonka,baitu habwanyu, bakahereza ebi ebimwagambirwe hati omuli ebo ababatebize enjiri omu Mwoyo Ogurukwera, ayatumirwe naruga omu iguru; nibyo bamaraika barukwegomba okuroramu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Fellow fools and weakhearted people do not believe everything the prophets said!
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Inywe abatanyina magezi, abobugara omu mitima okutaikiriza byona banabi ebibagambire!

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] Their end will come, their God will be their share, and their glory will be in their shame, and they will think about the things on earth.
lunyoro: empero yabu kuhwereke'ra, Ruhanga wabu niyo enda yabu, nekitinisa kyabu kirir omu nsoni zabu, nibo barukutekereza ebya hansi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] In this way his body, which is the means by which he is the one who makes all things perfect.
lunyoro: nugwo mubirigwe, okuhiki'ra kwogu arukuhikiriza byona omu byona.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] Judah was the father of Perez by Hezron, and Hezron was the father of Aram.
lunyoro: Yuda akazara Perezi akazara herezoni; Herezoni akazara Ramu

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] No one has ever saved me from my first trials, but they have all left me. I beg you, then, not to save me from this.
lunyoro: Omu kwetonganira kwange okwokubanza busaho ayankonyire, baitu bona bakampemukaho: ninsaba baleke okujunwa eki.

english: [AGRICULTURE] [AGRICULTURE] Even now the tree is cut down to the ground, so that it will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
lunyoro: Na hati bunu ebdyamiti etairwe ha kikoro kyemiti: nukwo omuti gwona ogutarukwana byona ebisemire bagutema, bagunaga mu mu'ro.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] So be glad and rejoice, you heavens and all you that are in them! How terrible for the earth and the sea! The Devil has come down to you, because he knows that you have only a little time left!
lunyoro: Nukwo musemererwa iguru nabarukuikaramu. Ziribabona ensi nenyanja: baitu Diaboro asirimukire halinywe ayina ekiniga kingi, baitu abaoine ngu ayina akacu kake.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] After Jesus left, he said, “Now the Son of Man has been made great, and God has been glorified through him.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okuturuka Yesu yagamba ati Hati bunu Omwana womuntu anyumizibwe, na Ruhanga anyumizibwe omuruwe;

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] and the repentance and the forgiveness of sins were preached in his name to all the nations, beginning in Jerusalem.
lunyoro: kandi okwegarukamu nokuihibwaho ebibi btebezebwe omu ibararye hali amahanga gona, okubandiza Yerusalemu.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] For we know that all creation keeps under control and continues to this very day.
lunyoro: Baitu tumanyire ngu ebihangirwe byona nibisinda nibisasira hamu okuhikya na hati.

english: [GOVERNMENT] [GOVERNMENT] You know the Law. You do not commit murder, do not commit adultery; you do not steal; you do not steal; you do not steal; you do not steal; you do not steal; you do not steal; you do not steal; you do not respect your father and your mother.
lunyoro: Omanyire ebiragiro. Otaliita, otalisihana, Otaliiba, otalihangi'ra, ataligobeza, obatinege 'so na nyoko.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] So then, if the whole church is united, and everyone speaks in strange tongues, and people who do not believe or who do not believe in the gospel enter it, will not say, “You have been crucified!”
lunyoro: Nukwo ekanisa yona obweba eso'rokaine hamu, kandi bona nibagamba endimi, kandi abantu abatamanyire, rundi abatarukuikiriza obubaliba nibatahamu, tibaligamba ngu Mugwire iraro?

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] The High Priest said to him, “I publicly praise God the living God, who told us that you are the Messiah, the Son of God!”
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yaculera. Nyakatagara omukuru wabu yamugambira ati Ninkurahiza Ruhanga omowmezi, otugambire obworaba ali Kristo, Omwana wa Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] When the two blind men who had been sitting on the cross heard that Jesus was passing by, they fell down before him and said, “Son of David, have mercy on us, Lord!”
lunyoro: Dora, abafu bamaiso babiri abakaba baikalire ha muhanda rubaju, obubahulire ngu Yesu nahinguraho, batokera ha iguru, nibagamba ngu Mukama waitu otuganyire, iwe Omwana wa Daudi.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] and the smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever; they have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and its image, and all those who believe in the image of the beast.
lunyoro: nomuika ogwokubonabonesebwa kwabu nugucuka ebiro nebiro, kunu tibayina okuhumura nyamusana nekiro, abaramya ekisoro nekisisani kyakyo, na bona abaikiriza enkojo yibara ryakyo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] For you were bought with a price. In the same way you were made with God in your body.
lunyoro: baitu mukagurwa nomuhendo: nukwo mukugize Ruhanga omu mubiri gwanyu.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] They had come back to that country and had told them to go back home.
lunyoro: Kandi kakuba babaire nibaijuka ensi egi nambere barugire, bakubaire nomwanya okugarukayo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] They sang a new song, saying, “You must take the book and expose its meaning; you have killed and redeemed God's people from every tribe, language, and nation.
lunyoro: Kandi bazina ekizina ekihyaka, nibagamba ngu Osemerire okutwara ekitabu, nokusumu'ra emanyikirizo zakyo: baitu okaitwa, kandi wabagu'ra Ruhanga obwesagama yawe omu ruganda rwona, norulimi, nabantu, nihanga,

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] I am coming to Zion for a very precious stone, and those who believe in him will not be disappointed.
lunyoro: Dora ninta omu Sayuni ibale erikomerwemu, eryomuhendo mwingi: Kandi arukumuikiriza talikwatwa ensoni.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] When the disciples heard this, they went away and took the body away and buried it.
lunyoro: Kandi abegeswabe obubahulire, baija, batwara omutumbigwe, baguta omu kituro.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] Whoever is born of God does not continue to do it, but remains in him; and whoever is born of God cannot sin.
lunyoro: Wena azairwe Ruhanga takora ki, baitu embiboye ikara omuruwe; kandi tasobora okukora kibi, baitu azairwe Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] All of us, together with our uncovered eyes, are changed from glory to glory by the Spirit, just as the Lord is with us.
lunyoro: Naitwe itwena namaiso agataswekerirwe, obutwangasana nkendolerwamu ekitinisa kya Mukama, tuhindurwa okusisanizibwa tuti okuruga omu kitinisa okuhika omu kitinisa, nka habwa Mukama waitu Omwoyo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “I have done one work, and you are all amazed.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nabagambira ati Nkakora omulimu gumu, nanywe inywena mwahuni'ra.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] For the gift of God's grace and of his free will is beyond compare.
lunyoro: Baitu ebisembo ebyembabazi nokweta ebya Ruhanga tibirukuhindurwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] and said, “Look! The heavens are opened up, and the Son of Man is seated at the right side of God.”
lunyoro: nagamba ati Dora, mboine iguru lisukuirwe, Nomwana womuntu ayemerire ha mukono ogwoburyo ogwa Ruhanga.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] Greet one another without grumbling.
lunyoro: kandi numukunirangana hataroho okuhyema,

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] For the truth is that you say, ‘Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will go up into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down from death.)
lunyoro: Baitu okuhiki'ra okwokuikirirza nukugamba kuti Otagamba omu mutima gwawe oti Oha alitemba omu iguru? (nukwo kusirimura Kristo hansi:)

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] He did not spare the ancient world, but saved Noah and the seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood upon the world of ungodly people.
lunyoro: kandi ataganyire ensi eyaira, baitu akakiza Nuha nabandi omusanju, omudumi wokuhiki'ra, obuyalesere okusandara kwamaizi ha nsi eyabatarukutina Ruhanga;

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] When Jesus saw the crowd rushing in with him, he said to him, “You dumb and deaf spirit, I have told you, and you will never give up.”
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyaboine ekitebe nikiiruka nikigoma namberali hamu, yacomera omuzimu omubi, nagugambira ati Iwe omuzimu ogutarukugamba, omufu wamatu, nyowe nkuragire omurugeho, otalimugarukira na kake.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] We have become like Sodom, and we have been like Gomorrah.
lunyoro: Twakufokere nka Sodomu, twakusiaine nka Gomora.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] All who heard it heard him and said in their hearts, “What will this child be?” But the hand of the Lord stayed with him.
lunyoro: Kandi bona ababihulire bakabyeyahu'ra omu mitima yabu, nibagamba ngu Mara, omwana ogu aliba ki? Baitu omukono gwa Mukama gwaikaraga hamu nauwe.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] And now you know what it is that is happening, so that it may be revealed by your deeds.
lunyoro: kandi hati bunu ekirukutanga mukimanyire, nukwo asuku'rwe omu mpikoze.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] In this way we will know that we are truthful and that we will establish our hearts straight ahead.
lunyoro: Nuho turukumanyira ngu tuli bamazima, kandi tuligumyaho omutima gwaitu omu maisoge,

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] Jesus left them and saw them following, and he said to them, “What are you looking for?” They answered, “Teacher,” (which means “Teacher”).
lunyoro: Yesu yakubutuka yabarora nibakuratira, yabagambira ati Nimuse'ra ki? banugambira ngu Rabi, ( amakuru gakyo obukimanyisibwa ngu Omwegesa), Orara nkaha?

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] But consider this man, who was highly respected by the father of Abraham, who had ten hundred coins on his altar of self-control.
lunyoro: Baitu mutekereze omuntu ogu okwali omukuru muno, Iburahimu isenkuru ouyahaire ebicweka biikumi ha munyago ogwokwegomboza.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] They had taken many spears and had them thrown into prison and ordered the jailer to keep them safe.
lunyoro: Obubabatire emiigo nyingi, babacumiriza omu nju yenkomo, nibaragira omulinzi okubalinda muno:

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] I will send the younger ones to you, and they will have children. They will build houses and have no need for the Kingdom of Heaven.
lunyoro: Nikyo ndukwendera abakyali abato baswerwe, bazale abana, baleme enju zabu, baleke okuha omunyanzigwa omwanya Ogwokujuma:

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] For I am afraid that, as the serpent deceived Eve in his lie, your minds will never be corrupted from the truth and the sacred things of Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu ntinire, nkenjoka okuyabihihire Hawa omu budupebwe, rundi ebitekerezo byanyu bitasisikara okuruga omu mazima nokwera ebiri hali Kristo.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] For we have heard that some among you who do not do what is right do not only what they do but also what others do.
lunyoro: Baitu tuhulire ngu haroho abamu abatarukugenda kurungi omulinywe, kunu tibakora emirimo yabu bonka, baitu nibakora eyabandi.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] Just as a man who left his house and lived in a foreign country, when he ordered his servants to build a tower, he ordered them to look straight ahead.
lunyoro: Nkomuntu ayasigire enjuye,narara omu nsi endi, amazire okuragira abairube rubale, nokubaha emirimu yabu omuomu, naragira omukurmirizi okurora.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] Others said, “Let us see whether Elijah will come to save him.”
lunyoro: Baitu abandi bagamba ngu Leka; turole rundi Eriya araija okumujuna.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] “What do you want?” they asked. “The Lord is looking for,” they answered.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwarabakaguza ngu Nimugusiburu'ra ki? Nuko muragamba muti Mukama waitu naguse'ra.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] But if anyone does not provide for himself and for his own family, he will not believe. And even worse is the evil one who does not believe.
lunyoro: baitu omuntu wena obwatalisa abe wenka, nokukira muno abomu njuye, buli ayehakaine okuikiriza. Nakira obubi atarukuikiriza.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] These things happened to them as examples, but they were written for a warning to us who have died to the ends of the world.
lunyoro: Kandi binu bikabaho abo okuba ekyokuro'raho; baitu bikahandikwa obwokutuhabura itwe abaizirwe emperor zensi.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] He got into the boat with them, and the wind came up, and they were very amazed among themselves.
lunyoro: Yatemba omu bwato nambere bali, omuyaga gwayamuka: bahuni'ra muno omunda yabu;

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Go and get the vineyard, and I will pay you what is right.”
lunyoro: nabo yabagambira ati Nainywe mugende omu rugonjo orwemizabibu, nanyowe ndabahera ekiraseme'ra.

lunyoro: baitu mukyali abomubiri: baitu obuharumu omulinywe ihali nempaka, timukyali bomubiri? Timurukugenda nkabantu kwonka?

lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yabagambira ati Busaho ekirikubabinga; inywe mubahe ebyokurya.

lunyoro: okwomukama wawe. Nogu owuyahairwe etaranta ibiri yaija nagamba ati Mukama wange okansigira etaranta ibiri; dora nkagobamu etaranta ibiri ezindi.

lunyoro: Bona Isenyowe abampa baliija namberendi; anyakuija namberendi tindimubingira aheru na kake.

lunyoro: Abafalisayo bahu'ra ebitebe nibagambirangana bati haruwe; banyakatagara abakuru Nabafalisayo batuma abaduma okumukwata.

lunyoro: kandi okuruga omu buto okamanya ebyahandikirwe ebirukwera, ebirukusobora okukuhaisa amagezi hali okujunwa, obwokuikiriza okuli omu Kristo Yesu.

lunyoro: ntutemba hali Yerusalemu; Omwana womuntu alihebwayo hali banyakatagara abakuru nabahandiki; nabo balimucwera omusango okumuita,

lunyoro: Baruka ekondo eyamabwa, bagita ha mutwegwe, nengoro omu mukonogwe ogwoburyo: bateza amaju omu maisoge, nibamute'ra enaku, nibagamba ngu Mirembe, Mukama wa bayudaya.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] The rooster crowed and said in a loud voice, “Surely not! I will do it, because my master has come to sow seed! I am ashamed to beg you!”
lunyoro: Omukoto yagamba omu ndaye ati Ndakora nta, baitu omukama wange anyakire obuketo? Tinyina mani gokulima; kandi nkwatwa ensoni okulega.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] and said, “Praise be to God, Lord Almighty, who lives and who lives forever! For he has made you strong, mighty!”
lunyoro: nibagagamba ngu Ntukusima iwe Mukama Ruhanga Owobusobozi bwona, anyakuroho, kandi ayabaireho; baitu okwasire amani gawe amaingi, nolema.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] Even though you have ten teachers in Christ, you have few fathers. For in union with Christ Jesus you have few children.
lunyoro: Baitu nobumuraba munyina abesegesa kakumi omu Kristo, timunyina baisinywe baingi: baitu ninyowe nabazaire omu Kristo Yesu omu njiri.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] But if I boast about him in all I do, I am not ashamed of him. For as we have told you all the truth, so our boasting in Titus was about the truth.
lunyoro: Baitu obunayenyumize omu kigambo kyona habwanyu haruwe, ntakwate ensoni; baitu nkokutwabagambire inywe byona omu mazima, nukwo nokwenyumiza kwaitu hali Tito kukaba kuli kwa mazima.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] But not one of these little ones who believe in me should have taken him to the beach and thrown him out of the lake.
lunyoro: baitu wena alitabaijura omu hali banu abato abarukunyikiriza, hakire bamubohe omu bikya orubengo orukoto, bamunage omu nziha yenyanja.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] Two women will be grinding at the hand mill, one will be taken away and the other will be taken away.
lunyoro: Abakazi baliba babiri nibasahamu; omu alitwarwa, ondi alisingwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] The Pharisees said to one another, “Look how weak he is! Look! The whole world is following him!”
lunyoro: Kandi Abafalisayo bagambirangana ngu Murole okumutarukusobora na kake; dora, ensi yona nemukuratira.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] I have sent you to Crete to finish what I had left behind, and to appoint elders in all the cities.
lunyoro: Nikyo nakulekire omu Kulete osemeze ebyasigalire, kandi oteho abakuru omu mbuga zoona,

lunyoro: Kandi nyakatagara wa Zeu akaba ali omu maiso gorubuga, akaleta ente nemikako eyebyakyo ha malembo nayenda okusara ekyonzira hamu nebitebe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [RELIGIOUS] For I am not afraid to tell you all the wisdom of God.
lunyoro: Baitu ntatine okubagambira amagezi gona aga Ruhanga.

lunyoro: kandi balenga okuhama nibarora ebifuna amakumi abiri: kandi obwahinguireho kakaito bagaruka okulenga okuhama, nibarora ebifuba ikumi na bitano.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] But Paul appealed to the Emperor to be kept under guard and ordered him to be kept under guard until I could send him to the Emperor.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] So then, do not let your good be saved.

lunyoro: Muleke binyete byona, bihike ha magesa: omu biro ebyokugesa ndigambira abagesi nti Mubanze musoroze emberya, muzibohe enganda bazokye: baitu oburo mubuhunike oku maguli gange.

lunyoro: Abafalisayo babagarukamu ngu Kandi ahabisize nainywe?

lunyoro: Abakaba bebembire, nabali abakuratire, bagambire nabali abakuratire, bagambira haiguru ngu Hosana; Ahairwe omugisa arukuija omu ibara rya Mukama:

lunyoro: Baitu ningamba nti ebi Abamahanga ebibahonga, babihongera abacwezi, kunu tihali Ruhanga: kandi tindukugonza inywe okuterana nabacwezi.

lunyoro: Ekiro kihinguire muno, obuire nubu'sa okukya: nukwo tujule engeso ezomuirima, tujwale ebyokurwanisa ebyomusana.

english: [GENERAL] [GENERAL] When we heard this, we and the people in that place begged him not to go to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Obutwahulire ebi, itwe nabantu abomu kiikaro eki, twamwesengereza aleke okutemba Yerusalemu.

lunyoro: Nukwo, muboine ebi tibisoboka okwangwa, kibahikirire inywe okuculera, okutakora kintu nimwanguhiriza.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] That is why Moses ordered you to circumcise a boy, not Moses, but your ancestors; and on the Sabbath you circumcise a human being.
lunyoro: Musa nikyo yabaherire okusara ( tukuli kwa Musa, baitu nukwo kwa baisenkuru inywe); kandi ha Sabiti musara omuntu.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] Believe me, then, that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; and you believe me only because of what I do.
lunyoro: Munyikirize ngu nyowe ndi omuli Isenyowe, na isenyowe omuli nyowe: rundi Munyikirize habwemirimo yonka.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] It gives me proof of what I am doing, and I do not want to come to you to have life.
lunyoro: bimanyisa ebyange; kandi timurukwenda kuija namberendi mube nobwomezi.

english: [GENERAL] [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] You Capernaum, who are highly respected by God, will you be raised to life by the power of the Spirit?
lunyoro: Naiwe Kaperenaumu, olinyumizibwa haiguru muno? Olisirimurwa okuhika okuzimu.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] The next day Cornelius was waiting for them, so he gathered his relatives and his friends and friends together.
lunyoro: Obuire obubwakire nyenkya bataha Kaisaliya. Kandi Koruneryo akaba nabategereza, amazire okusoroza aborugandarwe nabakaba abri enganjanize.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] It is good to give glory, honor, and power to you, Lord our God. You have created all things, and just as you wanted them to be, they existed and were given as you pleased.
lunyoro: Osemire, ai Mukama Ruhanga waitu, okuhabwa ekitinisa nokutinwa nobusobozi: baitu niwe wahangire byona, kandi nkokuwagondeze bikabaho, kandi bikahangwa.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] Try to enter the closed door, because many people will try to enter, but they will not be able.
lunyoro: Mwekambe okutaha omu irembo erifunzire: baitu nimbagambira nti Baingi abalise'ra okutahamu, tibalisobora.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] But you have been merciful to those in prison, and you endured with joy the loss of your riches. You know that you have a better and eternal life.
lunyoro: Baitu mukaganyira abo abakaba bali omu nkomo, kandi mukagumisiriza nokusemererwa okunyagwaho ebiitungo ryanyu, mumanyire ngu inywe munyina itungo erirukukira oburungi, kandi erirukuikaraho.

english: [GENERAL] [RELIGIOUS] The Pharisees answered, “How did he do to you?”
lunyoro: Abafalisayo babagarukamu ngu Kandi ahabisize nainywe?

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] For those who have something will be given more, and those who don't have will have more than they have, and all that they have will be taken away from them.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakuina, nuwe alihebwa: akandi atanyina, aliihibwaho nakyo ekyanyinakyo.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] These are the things that are like these in these modern times. They have increased the sacrifices and the sacrifices that cannot be made to serve the one who serves the one whose heart is pure, but who boasts of what is in their hearts.
lunyoro: ebigambo ebinikyo kisisani omu biro bya hati bunu: nikyo bahongera ebisembo nebyonzira ebitarukusobora okuhikiriza arukuramya omu bigambo ebyomu mutima, baitu

english: [GENERAL] [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] But they did not recognize him, so he put on his clothes and said to them, “You must put your own blood on your own heads. I am not guilty. From now on I will go to the Gentiles.”
lunyoro: Kandi obubamutangire nibajuma, yakunkumura ebyokujwarabye, nabagambira ati Esagama yanyu ikale ha mitwe yanyu enywenka; nyowe tindoho musango: okubanza hati ndagendaga hali Abamahanga.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] The night is almost over, and the day is almost here. Let us, then, be full of practices that please the darkness, and let us take up weapons for the light.
lunyoro: Ekiro kihinguire muno, obuire nubu'sa okukya: nukwo tujule engeso ezomuirima, tujwale ebyokurwanisa ebyomusana.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] That is why you must give to the poor my money, and when I come, I will receive it back with interest.
lunyoro: nikyo kyakuhikirire okuha abaguzi efeza yange, nanyowe obunakuizire nakuhairwe eyange namagoba gayo.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] See, then, that these things cannot be hid from you; you must be quiet and do nothing while you wait for me.
lunyoro: Nukwo, muboine ebi tibisoboka okwangwa, kibahikirire inywe okuculera, okutakora kintu nimwanguhiriza.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] The one who sent me is what he wanted: ‘Do not lose anything he has given me, but I will raise him to life on the last day.’”
lunyoro: Ayantumire ekyagonza nikyo kinu ngu Ha kyona ekyampaire haleke okuburaho na kake, baitu nkiimukye ha kiro kya hampero.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] Simon Peter went in and went into the tomb, where he saw the linen cloths lying.
lunyoro: baitu atatahemu. Kandi na Simoni Petero, yaija omukuratire, yataha omu kituro; yarora engoye zekitani zitairwe aho,

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] Pilate said to them, “Take him down and crucify him, because I find no reason to condemn him.”
lunyoro: Kandi banyakatagara abakuru nabahereza obubamubaine, batokera haiguru nibagamba ngu Bamba ha muti, bamaba ha muti. Pirato yabagambira ati Mumutwale inywe, mumubambe hamuti: baitu nyowe timboine musango haruwe.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] As you have given him authority over all flesh, he will give eternal life to all those you have handed him.
lunyoro: nkokuwamuhaire obusobozi ha banyakuina omubiri bona, bona abawamuhaire, abahe obwomezi obutahwaho.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] In this way we will celebrate the Passover, not with a conscience or with an evil conscience, but with things that are not based on legends and legends.
lunyoro: nukwo tucumbe obugenyi, hatali nekititumbisa ekiitima nobubi, baitu nebitatumbisibwa ebyobutagobya namazima.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] The king praised that dishonest accusation, but he was wise. The people of this world are much more shrewd than the people of the day in their own order.
lunyoro: Kandi mukamawe akanyumiza omuketo ogu atali wokuhiki'ra, baitu akagira amagezi: baitu abana abensi enu, omu businge bwabu, nibakira amagezi abana abomusana.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [REERAL] The more believers in the Lord, the more bold they were to speak the word of God without fear.
lunyoro: na bene baitu abakira obwingi omu Mukama waitu bakatunga obumanzi obwensengo zange, nibeyongera okuguma muno okugamba ekigambo kya Ruhanga okutatina.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] You should not have pity on your fellow servant, just as I had mercy on you.
lunyoro: obwokunyesengereza, naiwe tikikusemerire okuganyira omuiru omutahi wawe, nka nyowe okunakuganyire iwe?

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] Paul stood up at the gates and defended the people with his hand. After the uproar had subsided, he spoke in Hebrew to them,
lunyoro: Obuyamuikirize, Pauro yayeme'ra ha matembero, yaculeza abantu nomukono; obubamazire okuculera muno yabagambira omu rulimi Oruheburaniya nagamba ati.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] But they did not do it, because they put heavy loads on their shoulders and put them on the shoulders, but did not want to put them to the test by themselves.
lunyoro: bagamba,kunu tibakora. Baitu baboha enketo ezirukulemera,ezitetweka, ba zitweka abantu ha mabega; baitu bo tibenda kuzitengesa ne kyara kyabu.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] Blind people and those who are foolish do not love one another, and do not despise one another.
lunyoro: abadomadoma, abasisa ebi baragana, abatagonzangana, abatayina kuganyira:

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] They will run away from the Devil's trap, after which he will lead you into doing what he wants you to do.
lunyoro: kandi balitami'ruka okuruga omu ndubatira ya Setani, ogu obuyamazire okubahamba okukora nkoli okuyagondeze.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] You are our letter, which is known to everyone.
lunyoro: Ninywe baruha yaitu, erukumanywa erukusomwa abantu bona;

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] To be honest, self-controlled, and self-control. There is no law against such things as these.
lunyoro: okwesigwa obuculezi, okwerinda: hali ebirukusisa biti busaho kiragiro.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [REGOVERNMENT] For a man must not cover his head, but he is a copy of God's glory. For a woman is a man's honor.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimakwo omusaija tikimusemerire okwesweke'ra omutwe, baitu nuwe kisisani nekitinisa kya Ruhanga: baitu omukazi kiba kitinisa kyomusaija.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] For the first time he must suffer much and be rejected by the people of this world.
lunyoro: Baitu okubanza kimuhikirire okusalizibwa bingi nokuhakanwa abobusinge bunu.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] All those who live on earth will worship him, because the book of the living which was written in the Lamb's book of life has been lost since the creation of the world.
lunyoro: Kandi bona abaikara hansi balikiramya, wena atahandikirwe ibararyeomukitabu kyobwomezi Ekyokwana Gwentama ayaisirwe okuruga ha kuhangwa kwensi.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] The servants were so angry that they came to him and said, “Sir, don't you put a fine robe in your name, because it wasn't right for us to have any bread?”
lunyoro: Abairu rubale banyineka baija nibamugambira ngu Tata, otasige mbibo esemire omu ruharo rwawe, baitu ekaba eta okubamu emberya?

english: [GOVERNMENT] I do not order you by the Law, but by the will of others, to be truthful in your love.
lunyoro: Tindukuragira ekiragiro, baitu obwokwekamba kwa bandi, nindenga amazima agokugonza kwanyu.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] The owner of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my own dear son; they will not fear him.’
lunyoro: Omukama worugonjo yagamba ati Ndagira nta? Ndituma omwana wange oundukugonza; rundi balimutina.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] But what does it mean to say that your sins have been forgiven or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?
lunyoro: baitu ekirahuka kiraha? Okugamba nti ebibi byawe bikuihirweho, rundi okkugamba nti Imuka ogende?

english: [RELIGIOUS] [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] Where did this come from, my mother, my Lord?
lunyoro: Kandi nyowe ekigambo kinu kyaruga nkaha, nyina Mukama wange okuija namberendi?

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] He will not go into anything that is not good, nor will he go into the house of a thief or a robber. Instead, they will be written in the Lamb's book of the living.
lunyoro: kunu tihalitahamu na kake ekintu kyona ekitali kisemeri, nobwakuba anyakukora ebyomuziro nebisuba: rundi abo bonka bahandikwa omu kitabu ekyobwomezi Ekyomwana Gwentama.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] Out of the mouth come forth cursing and cursing. My friends, these things ought not to happen to you.
lunyoro: Omu kanwa kamu numwo harugamu okukugia nokukyena. Bene baitu ebi tibisemerire okuikara biti.

english: [EDUCATION] [ERICULTURE] [RELIGIOUS] That is what you have done, and you will teach.
lunyoro: Nibyo oragirege, kandi obyegesege.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] They refuse to give up, because they themselves are slaves of sin; but the person who has been redeemed is slaves of that slave.
lunyoro: nibaraganiza okubaha obugabe, baitu bo bonka bali abairu rubale abokujunda; baitu omuntu ekyasingurwa, nikyo aba muiru rubale wakyo.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] Philip answered him, “For two hundred silver coins he did not need to pay you, and for a little while we all did.”
lunyoro: Firipo yamugarukamu ali Emigati eyomuhendo edinali bikumi bibiri teyakubaigusize, bona okukomaho kake.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] He has entrusted us with everything that he has entrusted to us in all his wisdom and insight.
lunyoro: eziyasigisize namberetuli omu magezi gona nokwetegereza kwona,

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] For each one will prove himself faithful to his own work, and then he will have his own glory, not only for himself.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena ayerengere omulimogwe wenka, kandi nukwo abe nokwenyumizakwe habwe wenka, kunu tihali habwondi.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] And these things we write down for our own good.
lunyoro: nebigambo binu itwe tubihandikire okusemererwa kwaitu kuhiki'le.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] For this is what God has promised: ‘At the right time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.’”
lunyoro: Baitu ekigambo kinu nugwo murago ngu Nkebiro binu okubiri, nubwo ndiija, kandi Sara aliba nomwana.

english: [GENERAL] [RELIGIOUS] Do not be fooled by the many new and strange teachings. It is good to be filled with pity and compassion. This is not because of the food that has not been eaten by those who have not followed them.
lunyoro: Mutahabisibwa ebyokwegesa ebyemitingo nyingi ebihyaka: Baitu kirungi omutima okugamibwa nembabazi: okunu okutagumibwa nengeso ezokurya ezitarangasire abo abazigendiremu,

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] The world cannot hate you, but it hates me, because I tell it that its ways are evil.
lunyoro: Ensi tesobora kubanoba; baitu enobere nyowe, baitu nyowe nimanyisa ebyayo nti emirimo yayo ebihire.

english: [EDUCATION] [ELIGIOUS] After saying this, Jesus went away and called Mary privately, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”
lunyoro: Obuyamazire okugamba ati, yagenda nayeta Maryamu owanyina omunsita, nagamba ati, yagenda nayeta Maryamu owanyina omunsita, nagamba ati Omwegesa aizire, nakweta.

english: [GENERAL] [RELIGIOUS] His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews. But they had already decided that if anyone said that he was the Messiah, he would be expelled from the synagogue.
lunyoro: Abamuzaire nikyo bagambire ebi obwokutina Abayudaya: baitu Abayudaya bakaba bamazire kuhanura ngu Omuntu wena obwaramugambagambaga ati nuwe Kristo abingi bwege omu iso'rokaniro.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] He who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.
lunyoro: arukubeta wokwesiga, kandi nuwe alikora.

english: [GOVERNMENT] [Glaw] [GENERAL] For each one of you has obeyed all the commandments and has done them one thing, and you have been condemned in all things.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena nabwakwata ebiragiro byona, kandi nasobyaho ekimu, buli agwerirwe omusango gwa byona.

english: [GENERAL] [RELIGIOUS] He himself gave himself as a ransom for all, and the message will be preached in all creation.
lunyoro: ayayehaireyo wenka okubaekicunguro ekya bona; okumanisa kulibaho omu mpiko zakwo:

english: [GENERAL] [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] But they did not see his body, and came to him and said, “He is alive!”
lunyoro: kandi obubatazoire mutumbigwe, baija nibagamba ngu baboine nokwolekwa okwa bamaraika abagambire ngu Ayomire.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] When the angel went in with him, he called two of his family members to him and appointed a jailer over those who sent him to be the one who was in need.
lunyoro: Kandi maraika ayabalize nauwe obuyagenzire, yayeta abairube babiri abomu nju, na muserukale omwerinzi hali abo abamuherezaga obutosa;

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] You are our glory and our joy.
lunyoro: Baitu ninywe kitinisa kyaitu nokusemererwa kwaitu.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] Our ancestors worshiped on this mountain, and you say that in Jerusalem is the place where people should worship.
lunyoro: Baisenkuru itwe baramyaga ha rusozi runu; nainywe mugamba ngu Ha Yerusalemu nuho Kisemereire abantu okuramizaga.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] That is why I did not think it proper for me to speak on my own behalf, so that my servant will get well.
lunyoro: nikyo ntayetekererize nyenka okuseme'ra okuija nambo kwonka, omwojo wange arakira.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] Teach them to obey all that I have commanded you. And I am with you always, to the end of the age.
lunyoro: numubegesa okukwata byona ebinabaragire; kandi dora, nyowe ndi hamu nainywe ebiro byona, okuhikya obusinge bunu obubulihwaho.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] He called him and said to him, “What do you want me to do with you? Turn from your sins, because you cannot remain in the judgment any longer!”
lunyoro: Yamweta, yamugambira ati Kiki kinu ekindukuhu'ra haliwe? Bara omuhendo ogwobuketo bwawe; baitu tokyasobora kuikara omuketo.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] For I tell you the Gentiles. As long as I am an apostle to the Gentiles, I honor my own self-will.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira inywe Abamahanga. Nukwo nyowe obumba ndi omukwenda hali Abamahanga, ninyumiza obukwenda bwange:

english: [GENERAL] [RELIGIOUS] He threw himself down at Jesus' feet and thanked him, and he was a Samaritan.
lunyoro: yayejumika hali ebigerebye, namusima: nogu akabali Musamaliya.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] before the throne of the kingdom of heaven, which is like a jasper, and between the throne and the four living creatures full of eyes, both before and behind.
lunyoro: nomu maiso gekitebe kyobukama enyanja yendo'rwamu erukusisana nka kurusitaro; na hagati yekitebe ekyobukama ebyomezi bina ebiijuire amaiso omu buso nenyuma.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] I know him, the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings. I am like him who died.
lunyoro: nyowe 'mumanye ogu, namani agokuhumbukakwe, nokuterana kwomu kubonabonakwe, ninsisanizibwa nokufakwe:

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] So they went off and found a donkey tied up in the back of the colt, and as they walked on, they forgot to sleep.
lunyoro: bagenda, basanga omwana gwenkaina bagusibikire ha irembo aheru omu ikute; bagusibura.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] You must raise Lot's wife.
lunyoro: Muikukege mukazi wa Ruta.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] For we are no longer proud of you, but we have given you a chance to boast about ourselves, so that you may have an answer for those who boast about things that are above, but not on your heart.
lunyoro: Baitu titurukugaruka okwenyumiza itwenka halinywe, baitu tubahaire inywe omwanya gwokwenyumiza habwaitu, nukwo mube nekyokugarukamu abo abanyakwenyumiriza ebyaharuguru, kunu tihali omu mutima.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] He is loved and works faithful in all he does for the believers and the guests.
lunyoro: Arukugonzebwa nokora omulimo ogwokwesiga omu byona ebyokora habwabu bene baitu kandi abagenyi:

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] “No one in your group is called by that name,” they answered.
lunyoro: Bamugambira ngu Busaho omuli bene banyu ayetwa ibara eri.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] How happy and happy it must have been to hear this! Your brother was dead, but now he is alive; he was lost, but asleep.
lunyoro: Baitu okukyanganuka nokusemererwa kisemire: baitu mugenzi wawe ogu akaba afire, kandi ayomire, akaba azahire, azahukire.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] But you have brought these men here who have not broken the walls or robbed our master's wife.
lunyoro: Baitu mulesere abantu banu, abatanyagire ebyomu mabandiro, nobukwakuba okujuma omucwezi waitu omukazi.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] But to those who do what is good, praise and glory, honor and peace, it is the first time that a Jew or a Gentile is circumcised.
lunyoro: baitu okusimwa nekitinisa nobusinge hali wena arukukora okurungi, okubanza Omuyudaya, kandi Nomuyonani:

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] But what you have heard from the beginning must remain in you. The things you have seen from the very beginning will remain in your hearts, and you will remain with the Son and the Father.
lunyoro: Baitu inywe ekimwahulire okuruga karanakara, nikyo kiikalege omulinywe. Ekimwahulire okuruga karanakara obukiraba nikiikara omulinywe, nainywe muraikaraga omu Mwana nomu Isitwe.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] So then, the overseer must be without fault, as a husband who is not his wife; he must be a husband without a husband; he should be a humble and hospitable; he will be a good shepherd; he cannot be a drunkard or a glutton;
lunyoro: Nukwo kihikirire omurolerezi okutabaho ekyokuhanwa, abe musaija womukazi omu, atali mutamizi, omwerinzi, akwata mpora, akunira abagenyi, wamagezi okwegesa; atakunganira amarwa, atatera;

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] I tell you that soon the Son of Man will come and destroy them. But when the Son Of Man comes, will he find faith on earth?”
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Alibaramu'ra bwango. Baitu Omwana womuntu obwaliija alisanga okuikiriza hansi?

english: [RELIGIOUS] [REDUCATION] [GENERAL] Put on the complete suit of armor from God, a worker who is not ashamed of him, who is able to speak the truth with all his heart.
lunyoro: Wekambe okweyoleka osimirwe hali Ruhanga, omukozi atarukukwatwa ensoni, anyakusobo'ra kurungi ekigambo kyamazima.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] And now the weeds are gathered at the roots of the trees. So every tree that does not bear good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu empango etairwe ha kikoro kyemiti: nukwo omuti gwona ogutarukwana byana ebisemire guratemwa, guranagwa omu mu'ro.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] Nor does anyone pour new wine into old wineskins, because the wine will burst the skins, and the skins will be ruined.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho omuntu ata amarwa agomutara'ra omu ndyanga ezikuzire; kakuba agira ati amarwa agomutara'ra gakutemuire endyanga zakusisikaire.

english: [GENERAL] [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] So he said, “Let those who have authority in you go to me and accuse that man of any sin he has committed.”
lunyoro: Nukwo yagamba ati; Abayina obusobozi omulinywe, basirimuke nanyowe, kandi obwaraba omusaija ogu aroho ekibi kyona, bamulege.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] He was changed in front of them, and his face shone like the sun, and all his clothes became like the light.
lunyoro: yahindurwa omu maiso gabu: amaisoge nigamulikana nkizoba, nebyokujwarabye nibyera nkomusana.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] But if you have poured this perfume on my body, you have used it as a perfume.
lunyoro: Baitui obwaseserege amagita ganu ga mubiri gwange, akikozire obwokuzika.

english: [GENERAL] [GENerAL] A man who was lame from birth had been carried by his mother, and the next day they threw him out of the Temple treasury, which is called the Holy Place, to tell those who had come into the Temple to be punished.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu akabali omulema okuruga omu nda ya nyina akaba bamuhimbire, oubabyamyaga obukyabukya ha ruigi orwa yekaru orurukwetwa Orurungi, okulega ebyokuganyira hali abo atahaga omu yekaru.

english: [GENERAL] [RELIGIOUS] I was in Joppa praying, and I saw something coming down that looked like a large sheet being lowered from heaven and coming down to me.
